2. In each of the five source files delete that one test function (and its now-orphaned comment). Then remove anything in that file only that test used (the `audit_package` import is expected to become unused; check `Path`, `ROOT` and every other name with a search of the file before removing it).
3. Edit no other file. Never weaken another test, never change a cap.

set -eo pipefail
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
F="tests/test_richer_1c.py tests/test_richer_2a.py tests/test_richer_2b.py tests/test_richer_2c.py tests/test_richer_3a.py tests/test_richer_overprojection.py"
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 $F 2>&1 | tail -4
.venv/bin/python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 tests/test_richer_overprojection.py 2>&1 | grep -c "test_the_richer_scene_adds_no_beat_overprojection\[" | grep -x 5
c=$(git grep -l "def test_the_richer_scene_adds_no_beat_overprojection" -- tests | tr '\n' ' ')

.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $F
git add -A -- tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -v -x -e tests/test_richer_1c.py -e tests/test_richer_2a.py -e tests/test_richer_2b.py -e tests/test_richer_2c.py -e tests/test_richer_3a.py -e tests/test_richer_overprojection.py || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
git diff --cached --binary > /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/richer-overprojection/overprojection.patch
test -s /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/richer-overprojection/overprojection.patch
